ns2:course.label: Molecular Genetics
ns2:course.description: Fundamentals of molecular biology including structure of DNA, RNA and proteins, mechanisms of DNA replication, transcription and translation, gene organization, genetic variation and repair, and regulation of gene expression in Bacteria, and Eukarya. Prerequisite: MCB 150, CHEM 102 and CHEM 104, or equivalents or consent of instructor.
